title: Upper Body Strength Focus with Core Stability

items.name: Cat-Cow
items.cues: Move slowly through the full range of motion. Inhale on cow, exhale on cat. Warm up the spine gradually.

items.name: Band Pullaparts
items.cues: Use a light resistance band. Pull the band apart with arms at shoulder height, squeezing shoulder blades together. Control the return.

items.name: Biceps Wall Stretch
items.cues: Place arms against wall at shoulder height. Step forward gently to stretch the chest and biceps. Hold each side for 20-30 seconds.

items.name: Bench Press
items.cues: Control the descent over 2 seconds. Press explosively. Keep shoulder blades retracted. Grip slightly wider than shoulder width.

items.name: Bent-Over Row
items.cues: Hinge at hips with slight knee bend. Row the bar to your lower chest. Squeeze shoulder blades at the top. Keep core engaged.

items.name: Assisted Dip
items.cues: Use assistance machine if available. Lower body by bending elbows to 90 degrees. Press back to start. Control the negative portion.

items.name: Cable Curl
items.cues: Use a straight bar attachment. Keep elbows fixed at your sides. Curl smoothly without swinging. Pause briefly at the top.

items.name: Cable Core Press
items.cues: Stand perpendicular to the cable machine. Press away from your chest explosively. Resist rotation. Brace your core throughout.

items.name: Bird Dog
items.cues: Move slowly and deliberately. Extend opposite arm and leg. Hold for 1-2 seconds. This develops core stability and mind-muscle connection.

items.name: 90/90 Hip Switches
items.cues: Sit with both knees bent at 90 degrees. Rotate hips smoothly side to side. Focus on hip mobility and flexibility.

items.name: Calf Stretch
items.cues: Stand facing a wall. Step one leg back and press heel to ground. Hold 30 seconds per leg. Keep hips square to wall.

rationale: Recent training shows heavy focus on bench press and mobility work; this session continues upper body strength development at RPE 6-7 intensity while avoiding excessive volume after back-to-back sessions.
Intermediate fitness level allows for 4-6 rep ranges on compound lifts (bench and rows) to build strength efficiently within the 55-minute window.
Included dynamic core exercises (Cable Core Press) and hip mobility (90/90 Hip Switches) to complement recent endurance training and maintain movement quality.
